Viewed from +Z (pod 1 nearest the viewer). X to the right, Y up. Deck top surface is y = 0.

Plan envelope: 30,396 m (X) × 28,860 m (Z); bounding circle Ø 34,040 m
Hub deck Ø 17,000 m; main dome Ø 15,200 m × 5,700 m high; pod decks Ø 6,600 m at 13,600 m from centre
Central hub deck diameter ~17 km (dome 15.2 km). Derived from the only available in-universe yardstick: street-level shots inside the Citadel (S3E7) show cars
(~4 m), which give building widths and the spacing between towers; extrapolating that to the exterior establishing shot gives a central disc roughly the size of
Brooklyn (~15-17 km across). This is the same reasoning used by the community 1:200 000 print model, which independently arrives at a Brooklyn-sized centre

Confidence: Exterior proportions are taken from the single recurring establishing shot (S1E10, S3E1, S3E7, S5E10). Everything above the deck plane is well attested; the underside and legs are seen only in that one 3/4 view and are partly inferred.
REFERENCES (episodes with the exterior establishing shot)

S1E10 Close Rick-counters of the Rick Kind — First exterior establishing shot: central glass dome, three smaller domed districts, stacked metallic plates below, three legs, single antenna. Orange/brown nebula backdrop.
S3E01 The Rickshank Rickdemption — Same exterior; Citadel teleported into the Galactic Federation prison and heavily damaged.
S3E07 The Ricklantis Mixup — Rebuilt Citadel, same silhouette. Street-level shots used for the scale basis.
S5E10 Rickmurai Jack — Exterior seen again before destruction; Mortyburg district detaches.
